title: Variational Network
paper_title: Learning a Variational Network for Reconstruction of Accelerated MRI Data
core_mech: 把多线圈 MRI 的变分梯度下降展开，并联合学习卷积滤波器、势函数与每级更新权重。
core_mech_en: Unrolls K steps of gradient descent on a generalized Fields-of-Experts variational energy for multi-coil MRI, jointly learning convolutional filters, non-linear potentials, and data weights.
input_desc: 欠采样多线圈 k-space y、采样掩膜 P 与线圈灵敏度 S
input_en: Undersampled multi-coil k-space data y, sampling mask P, and pre-estimated coil sensitivity maps S
output_desc: K 次变分更新后的复数 MRI 图像 x_hat
output_en: Complex-valued reconstructed MRI image x^{(K)} after K unrolled variational steps

adapter.name: Variational Network
adapter.mechanism: MRI energy-gradient updates use constrained convolution filters, learned RBF influence functions and coil-aware Fourier data gradients.
limitations: Small filter bank and three stages; synthetic smooth coil maps are supplied, not learned.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
